_meta.description: Fully synthetic LLM gateway fixture: fictitious clients, workflows, campaigns and cost centers; example.com addresses; 555-01xx phone number. No real accounts, usage or financial data.

scenarios.req-001: Low spend: cheap model, LLM OK
scenarios.req-002: Low spend: Anthropic prompt-cache read billed at the cache-hit rate
scenarios.req-003: Client soft cap (client_alpha passes 80%): Sonnet downgraded to Haiku, output clamped
scenarios.req-004: Client hard cap (client_beta): projected overrun trips the client scope -> template reply
scenarios.req-005: OpenAI 429 rate limit -> regex classification fallback
scenarios.req-006: Timeout -> regex extraction fallback; charged at the pre-flight estimate
scenarios.req-007: Shared cost center -> exact 60/40 split to cc-marketing / cc-sales; OpenAI cached tokens
scenarios.req-008: Success without a usage block -> charged at the pre-flight estimate
scenarios.req-009: Email and phone redacted before the provider call
scenarios.req-010: Unpriced model -> blocked (fail closed), regex fallback
scenarios.req-011: Input over MAX_INPUT_CHARS -> extractive summary, never sent
scenarios.req-014: Global soft cap crossed (approaching threshold): GPT-6 Astra downgraded to Luna
scenarios.req-015: Critical priority bypasses the soft cap (still bounded by hard caps)
scenarios.req-016: OpenAI insufficient_quota -> fallback; OpenAI breaker open until the next budget day
scenarios.req-018: Anthropic 429 rate limit (failure 2 of 3) -> regex classification
scenarios.req-019: Anthropic timeout (failure 3 of 3) -> regex extraction; Anthropic breaker opens for the cooldown
scenarios.req-020: Global hard cap trip: worst-case estimate exceeds the cap minus safety margin -> extractive summary
scenarios.req-021: After the trip: even a tiny request uses fallback rules (HARD_CAP_TRIPPED)
